notes: Them loai acc "Chua co 2FA (nap duoc)": acc bi ep 2FA nhung CHUA cai gi -> co the tu nap 2FA cua minh vao.
Loai nay xuat ra file rieng nap-2fa.txt + co bo loc + dem so, tach khoi 2FA da cai san (cung, khong vao duoc).

Them nut "Psiphon" - nguon IP THAT, sach, it bi Microsoft chan hon Tor. Bam la app TU TAI & chay, moi IP mot quoc gia khac nhau, gop chung voi Tor/Proxy free. CHI doi IP trong tool, KHONG can quyen admin.
Psiphon chon nuoc: CHUOT PHAI nut "Psiphon" de chon 1 trong 21 nuoc (My, Anh, Nhat, Duc, Sing...) hoac de "Tat ca" cho da dang IP nhieu nuoc.
Tor len IP NHANH hon HAN: sua loi so IP dang tang thi bi dung som -> gio chay du toi hang nghin luong, o proxy khong con giat lag.
Them nhieu nguon Proxy free moi (da kiem con song) -> nhieu IP hon.

Sua loi bam Start bi "do do cham cham" sau khi da chay 1 lan HOAC sau khi bat Tor IP: app nhe hon han, muot ca luc login voi hang nghin IP Tor (bo hang nghin luong nen thua + het quet lai o proxy moi lan Start).
